task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the calibration specification file at ~/Documents/cal_requirements.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of cal_requirements.txt.

task_completion.description: Agent produces the required 10 Bias frames in the calibration directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or terminal 'ls' output showing 10 files identified as Bias frames in /home/ga/Calibration.

task_completion.description: Agent produces the required 10 Dark frames at 300s and 10 Dark frames at 600s.
task_completion.visual_evidence: File listings showing 20 total Dark frames with filenames or metadata indicating the 300s and 600s exposure times.

task_completion.description: Agent produces the required Flat frames for V, R, and B filters (5 each).
task_completion.visual_evidence: File listings showing 15 total Flat frames (5 per filter) in the calibration directory.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a summary report confirming all frames are in place at the specified location.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file named calibration_summary.txt being saved or displayed, containing a count or list of the generated frames.

integrity.description: Agent should use calibration software or scripts rather than manually 'touching' empty files to mimic frames.
integrity.visual_evidence: The process of generation should involve a specific application or a script that simulates CCD capture, not just shell commands like 'touch'.

integrity.description: The summary report must reflect the actual files generated, not a pre-written template.
integrity.visual_evidence: The summary report content should match the timestamps and file counts observed in the file system screenshots.

integrity.description: Agent uses the correct root directory for output as specified in the system configuration.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show paths within /home/ga/Calibration, not temporary or default home directories.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required calibration library consists of: 10 Bias frames, 10 Dark frames (300s), 10 Dark frames (600s), 5 Flat-V frames, 5 Flat-R frames, and 5 Flat-B frames.
